port: The wave is a scaled cylinder section with a world-space mask and a distortion pass. The hostile smoke is a skeletal-mesh-sampled Niagara emitter whose colour curve is switched by an event. The halo is a torus mesh with an emissive curve; the turn is an animation montage.
notes: The hostile state is shown first: dark smoke with ember-red edges boiling off the body and two red eye points, lit by a dim red light.
The wave is a crescent of an open cylinder that expands from the caster with a bright foot, a soft crest and a ripple on the floor. Petals ride its crest.
Impact: smoke born before the wave is blown back and turns pale grey, the eyes go out, and a halo snaps on with a hard flash before settling.
Aftermath: the actor turns its back and lowers its head while petals spiral down around it and a faint rosette fades under its feet.

name: Depart the Abyss
src: Transports the user out of the Abyss to where they entered it.
blurb: Standing on the glassy floor of the Abyss, the worshipper rips a seam in the air, warm torchlight from the dungeon they left spills through, and they are drawn into it like thread before the tear snaps shut.
port: Niagara: shard mesh emitter with a gravity switch on a user event, a character world position offset material for the pull, and the tear as a masked card with a scene capture of the destination inside. The seam is a ribbon with an emissive cooling curve.

name: Banish
src: Attempts to banish a creature to the Abyss; those that resist are still malmutated and weakened.
blurb: A splinter of black glass flicked from the caster's hand bites the floor under the target, the stone opens into a turning shaft of nothing, and ribbons of abyssal glass wind around the victim and drag it down before the floor slams shut.
port: Unreal: the pit is a decal with a parallax interior cylinder in the material (or a stencil portal). Ribbons are Niagara ribbon emitters on a helix module, the shards a mesh emitter, and the target sink is gameplay animation plus a world position offset twist.

name: Brand Weapon With Distortion
src: One-time gift that permanently brands a melee weapon with distortion.
blurb: A sword hangs over Lugonu's broken spiral while a ring of black glass splinters winds in and drives into the steel; the blade splits into three phase-shifted copies, snaps back, and is left dark, veined and never quite in one place again.
port: Unreal: the brand is a material parameter blend on the weapon (emissive veins, fresnel, darkened base) plus a distortion mesh parented to the blade. Ghost copies are two extra mesh renders with world position offset driven by a damped spring curve.

name: Triple Draw
src: Draws three cards from a deck and lets the user choose one to play.
blurb: Three oversized vellum cards spring from the hand and flip face up; Nemelex chooses one, the other two burn away in violet edged fire, and the chosen card is slapped down onto the floor where its sigil brands the stone.
port: Niagara mesh renderer for the cards with a dynamic material parameter for the burn threshold and per card timing; ash as a sprite emitter spawned from a skeletal-less static mesh location module on the card. The floor sigil is a deferred decal with a cooling emissive curve.

name: Recall Orcish Followers
src: Recalled converted orc followers (pre-0.32 form of the recall).
blurb: The priest drives a horned war standard into the floor, its sigil flares with a horn call that rolls across the stones, and each follower is struck down beside it by a bronze bolt and steps out of the flash.
port: Unreal: a static mesh standard with a cloth simulation, a beam emitter with jitter for the bolts, and per character dynamic material overlay for the arrival glow. Scorch stars are decals.

name: Overgrow
src: Destroys walls or trees in an area and grows temporary plant allies in their place.
blurb: Gold sap light threads through the mortar of a ruined wall, the blocks burst apart, and gnarled roots braid up where it stood into a living tree that sheds leaves over the rubble.
port: A Chaos fracture cache for the wall, spline meshes or a baked vertex animation for the roots, a hierarchical instanced static mesh for the leaves, a moss decal with a growth mask and Niagara for dust and leaf fall.
notes: The wall is 15 instanced lit stone blocks. Tell: crack lines climb the blocks with gold sap light while grit trickles from the joints.
Impact: the blocks fly on closed-form ballistic arcs with one bounce, tumble and stay as rubble; a hard gold ring holds for two frames.
Twenty instanced roots grow from the old footing, converge into a braided trunk and splay into branches, followed by 160 instanced leaves that pop in behind the growth front.
Residue: rubble, a creeping moss decal, settling stone dust and leaves drifting down.

name: Sunlight
src: Lit an area with sunlight, evaporating water, revealing invisible monsters and reducing their accuracy (removed in 0.24).
blurb: A shaft of gold sunlight drives down into the crypt, boils a puddle off into steam and catches an invisible thing standing in it, which flinches into view.
port: A volumetric spotlight with a light function material for the gobo and a fog volume for the shaft. The creature uses a material that blends from a refraction-only pass to an opaque rim-lit pass, and the puddle is a decal with an evaporation mask.
notes: Tell: a hair-thin sliver of light and glinting motes appear above the puddle, while the hidden creature shows only as a refraction shimmer and ripples at its feet.
Impact: a raymarched cone of lit dust slams down and the floor pool holds a hard-edged disc for two frames; the pool is a gobo printed with the Fedhas growth rings.
The creature is a custom mannequin that goes from pure distortion to a pale, rim-lit body with both arms thrown up against the glare.
Residue: the water erodes away into cracked pale mud while lit steam rolls up through the shaft.

name: Evolution
src: Upgraded a plant or fungus ally into a stronger form (removed in 0.24).
blurb: A spindly sapling shudders as green light climbs its bark, then wrenches itself into a gnarled, thorned tree and sheds its old leaves onto fresh moss.
port: Two skeletal plant meshes with a blend-shape morph and a growth scalar, or a PCG foliage asset with per-branch growth curves. Leaves and pollen are Niagara mesh and sprite emitters keyed off the morph event.
notes: Tell: the fiddlehead spiral of Fedhas draws itself under the plant while glowing pollen streams from the hand and stress light climbs the bark.
Impact: trunk, nine branches and every leaf are scaled by one easeOutBack growth curve, so the whole plant overshoots and settles like a living thing.
Branches are instanced tubes bent along a quadratic curve; leaves are instanced alpha-clipped quads with a midrib and backlit translucency.
The old juvenile leaves are flung off, flutter down with drag and lie flat on a moss patch that spreads from the roots as residue.

name: Step From Time
src: Removes the user from the flow of time for a while; they return unchanged after monsters have wandered off.
blurb: A bronze-ringed hourglass of light closes around the worshipper, who runs down into it as sand; the glass stands empty while time flickers past, then the sand climbs back up into the same body.
port: Character dissolve material with a world-height threshold and edge emission, a sand cone mesh with a height parameter and Niagara sand ribbons that switch direction on a curve. The hourglass is a translucent refractive mesh with a bronze static frame.
notes: Tell: the scute dial draws under the feet and the hourglass fades in as a refracting fresnel shell inside a lit bronze frame.
The body is a custom mannequin clipped by a height threshold with a glowing sand edge; grains fall from the edge onto a lathe sand cone that grows as the body drains.
The empty beat is held: flicker in the effect light suggests hours passing, then the threshold reverses and grains rise from the cone back into the body.
The glass shatters into glints at the end and the spilt sand ring stays on the floor as residue.

name: Campfire
blurb: A stone ringed campfire: charred logs with glowing cracks, layered flame cards, lit smoke, embers and heat haze.
port: Niagara: two flame cards with a panning erosion material, plus sprite emitters for licks, smoke and embers. Use a light renderer with a curve driven flicker and feed the smoke material the same light colour as a dynamic parameter.
notes: Flames are two axis billboards. Each one thresholds vertically stretched noise that scrolls upward, and the threshold climbs with height so the top breaks into tongues.
Heat is one scalar. The same value drives alpha and the colour ramp, so the core is white, the body orange and the edge deep red without extra masks.
Logs and stones are one subdivided plane folded into fifteen capped cylinders and boulders in the vertex shader. Bark cracks glow where the wood sits in the fire.
Smoke is unlit grey plus fxLight(), so the underside of the column picks up the flicker of the point light.
The light flickers with three summed sines and also drifts sideways, which makes the stone shadows crawl.

name: Brazier
blurb: A carved stone brazier holding a tall stylised flame with a readable silhouette and banded colour.
port: Unreal: static mesh for the bowl with an emissive mask for runes and coals. The flame is two cards with a banded curve atlas lookup driven by the heat value, plus a small Niagara emitter for licks and embers.
notes: The bowl is one lathe profile that runs up the outside, over the lip and back down to a coal bed, so the interior needs no second mesh.
The flame heat field is quantised into four soft bands. That gives the hand painted look of a stylised ARPG flame while the motion stays procedural.
A narrow inner card with its own seed slides against the outer card, which reads as depth even though both are flat.
The rune band on the bowl is lit by the same tint and breathes slowly, tying the prop to the element of the fire.
Variants only change the tint and proportions. Every colour comes from one ramp, so soulfire and fel need no retuning.

name: Wall of Fire
blurb: A five metre wall of flame: ignition races along the line, the wall burns, then starves and leaves a glowing scar.
port: Niagara: spawn along a spline with spawn time offset by normalised distance. Flame cards are a ribbon or mesh with world aligned noise. Pass the burn value as a dynamic parameter to the erosion material and the decal.
notes: Every layer reads one function, burn(x, age). It delays ignition by distance along the line, so cards, particles, decal and lights stay in sync.
Flame noise is sampled in world space along the wall. Tongues therefore keep their width when the length parameter changes.
Two offset cards carry the body and billboarded licks break the flat silhouette, so the wall holds up from a three quarter view.
The leading edge gets a short overdrive and a spark burst: that is the impact beat. The die down erodes the wall from the top instead of fading it.
The scorch decal keeps hot cracks after the flames are gone, which sells the heat that was there.

name: Lava Flow
blurb: A molten floor material: flow mapped lava under drifting crust plates, with glowing cracks, bubbles that swell and pop, and heat haze.
port: Material graph: flow map texture plus a FlowMaps node, packed noise for cracks, and a zone mask as a scalar field or vertex colour. Bubbles can be a flipbook decal or the same cell hash in a custom node. Use a Niagara emitter with matching seeds for spatter.
notes: The flow vector is a meandering stream bent around the boulder with a potential flow term. The pattern is advected with the usual two-phase blend so it never visibly stretches.
One packed lookup gives crack lines and billows. A threshold driven by a slow temperature zone turns that into thin glowing seams in cool areas and open molten pools in hot ones.
Crust is lit: its normal comes from the gradient of the molten mask, so plates catch the stage key light and the effect lights.
Bubbles live in a grid of cells with hashed timing. The spatter particles evaluate the same hash in the vertex shader, so droplets leave exactly where a bubble pops.
Emission uses the single tint ramp. The hottest pools go to white, seams stay saturated and the fogged distance keeps a dull glow.

name: Volumetric Flame
blurb: A raymarched pillar of fire: 3D noise advected upward, shaded with an emission and absorption model and a blackbody style ramp.
port: Unreal: a Heterogeneous Volume or a ray marched material on a bounding mesh with a tiling volume texture. For gameplay budgets bake the result to a flipbook with 6-way lighting and use this version as the reference.
notes: Density is a tapering envelope plus two octaves of tiling 3D noise that scroll upward at different speeds. A height term raises the threshold so the top tears into separate tongues.
A low frequency lookup offsets the sample position sideways, more with height. That is the roll: the column bends and folds instead of scaling in place.
The same scalar is temperature. Hot samples are bright and nearly transparent, cool ones are dark red and absorb, so outer folds occlude the core and the volume reads as layered.
The march runs 44 jittered steps inside a bounding cylinder and stops at the scene depth, so the fire sits correctly behind and in front of geometry.
Sooty smoke is marched in the same loop around the tips, lit by the effect light.

name: Ember Storm
blurb: Hell zone atmosphere: embers lift out of glowing fissures and ride a turbulent wind through falling ash and red haze.
port: Niagara: GPU sprites with a curl noise force and a wind vector field. Spawn embers from a mesh or texture mask that matches the floor emissive. Haze maps to exponential height fog with an inscattering colour set by the zone.
notes: The floor fissures are a function, not a texture. The ember vertex shader samples it at each spawn point and hides particles born on cold ground, so embers visibly come from the cracks.
Motion is closed form: a rise term, a wind term that grows with height and curl noise whose amplitude scales with age. That reads as embers being caught by gusts.
A second, sparser layer of large soft embers near the camera gives depth without more overdraw.
Haze is an analytic height fog integral in a ray layer, limited by scene depth. It tints distance toward the element colour and costs one noise lookup.
Ash uses alpha blending and effect lighting, so flakes are dark against the glow and catch light near fissures.

name: Dragon Breath
blurb: A continuous jet of fire from a bronze spout: a white hot core, a widening turbulent cone, smoke where it stalls and light on the floor.
port: Niagara: cone velocity with drag and curl noise, size and colour over life from curves, sub UV erosion material. The core is a mesh strip with panning noise. Use a few light renderer particles or one rect light along the jet.
notes: Particles travel along the cone axis with a fast start and a slow finish. The same curve sets the cone radius, so the stream widens exactly where it slows down.
Heat is tied to particle age. Near the spout sprites are small, dense and white. At the far end they are large, eroded and deep red, then the smoke layer takes over.
A noise panned strip inside the cone gives the pressurised core. It is axis aligned to the jet, so it never shows its edge.
Turbulence and buoyancy scale with age squared. The jet leaves the spout straight and only starts to roll and lift once it has lost speed.
Three lights sit along the axis so the floor reads the length of the jet, and the smoke samples them through fxLight().

name: Shatter the Chains
src: Destroys a chosen cursed equipped item to remove the curse.
blurb: Three loops of tarnished iron chain cinch around a cursed amulet, burst link by link across the floor, and the amulet crumbles to dust in the caster's hands.
port: Niagara mesh renderer for the links with a collision module and a sleep state, the amulet as a dissolve material driven by one scalar, and a mesh decal for the sigil with an emissive curve.
notes: Tell: 45 instanced torus links tighten in three tilted loops while their etched glyphs and the curse gem heat up in Ashenzari teal and the floor sigil burns in.
Impact: every link becomes a ballistic body with tumble and one bounce, then settles flat on the floor. A broken ring flash holds for two frames.
The amulet is alpha eroded from the rim inward with a pale ash edge, shedding chip sprites that fall under gravity and pile into a dust decal.
Residue: scattered links, a dust pile and the cooled sigil lines stay on the floor until the loop ends.

name: Shadow Form
src: Turned the worshipper into a swirling mass of shadow with damage resistance at a cost (removed in the 0.32 rework).
blurb: Indigo veins climb the worshipper's armour until the plates burst away, leaving a ragged black body that bleeds smoke upward while the shed armour lies on the floor.
port: Character material swap driven by a dissolve front, Niagara mesh renderer for the shed plates with collision, a mesh-sampling smoke emitter, and a negative light component on the character.
notes: Tell: crack lines from the triplanar noise sheet climb the armour as an indigo front with the steel darkening below it, while dark motes are drawn into the body.
Impact: 36 instanced armour plates are thrown off on ballistic arcs with tumble and a bounce, and an eclipse corona flashes behind the head.
The form is the same mannequin with an ink material whose silhouette is alpha clipped by fresnel and rising noise, wrapped in a displaced smoke shell and a stream of lit wisps.
Residue: the shed plates stay on the floor around a soft umbra stain, and the room stays dimmer while the form holds.

name: Potion Petition
src: Pays gold to instantly receive the effects of one of three offered sets of potions.
blurb: Coins stream up from the worshipper's hands into the chosen of three offered flasks, which fills with molten gold and tips it over them in a shining pour that gilds the armour and sinks in.
port: Niagara mesh renderer for coins with curl orbits and a collision path for the misses, a glass material with a liquid level parameter, a spline mesh for the pour and a character overlay material with a world height mask for the gilding.
notes: Tell: three glass flasks appear overhead and 60 instanced gold coins spiral up from both hands. Ten miss, tumble and land on the floor where they stay.
Impact: the two rejected flasks erode into gold dust, the chosen one is full and tips, and a stamped coin face flashes for two frames.
The pour is a strip ribbon shaded as liquid metal with a moving front. A gilding mask runs down the armour with drip noise, then sinks in with a warm pulse.
Residue: shining splats on the floor that dull as they dry, and the scattered coins.

name: Call Merchant
src: Pays gold to have a shop set up at the user's location.
blurb: A shower of gold coins rattles onto the flagstones, a stamped coin sigil flares under them, and a gold-trimmed merchant stall springs up out of the pile with its lantern already lit.
port: Coins as a Niagara mesh emitter with collision and sleep. The stall as a prefab whose pieces animate in with a scale curve and a Sequencer stagger, a decal for the stamp and a point light with a flicker curve in the lantern.
notes: Tell: the worshipper flicks a purse of coins forward while 70 more fall from above. Every coin is a lit metal mesh with a stamped face that tumbles, bounces once and settles flat.
Impact: a coin face sigil stamps into the floor for two frames, then the stall pieces pop up in sequence with overshoot and throw a ring of lit dust.
The stall is one instanced box layer with a per-piece transform table: posts, counter, back panel, slanted roof, crates and a sign that swings on a damped spring.
Residue: coins stay scattered around the stall, dust settles, and the lantern keeps warm light on the counter.

name: Upheaval
src: Blasts a small targeted area with magma, ice, wind or rubble.
blurb: A knot of storm cloud gathers over the target, Qazlal quartered ring cracks into the floor, and one bolt of lightning unlocks a tight eruption of magma, ice, wind or rubble.
port: One Niagara system with four emitter groups gated by an element int, a shared cloud emitter and a beam emitter for the bolt; the ground ring is a decal with a crack mask driven by one scalar.
notes: Every Qazlal invocation shares the same tell: dark lit cloud gathering overhead with lightning flickering inside, and the quartered storm ring cracking into the stone.
Impact is a single hair-thin bolt held for three frames, then the chosen element: a magma geyser with glowing crust chunks, a cluster of ice spikes, a whirlwind of grit, or a rock blast.
All four elements share one debris layer of instanced rock meshes whose material and motion switch on the element parameter, so the code path stays small.
Residue matches the element: a cooling lava pool, standing ice and frost, a swept spiral scour, or a crater ringed with stones.

name: Grand Finale
src: Merges with a target and bursts out of it, killing it instantly and placing the user at its location.
blurb: The dancer dives into a foe inside a spiral of crimson silk, the body throbs three beats faster and faster, then bursts into gore, silk scraps and brass foil with the dancer standing where it stood.
port: Niagara: the dive is a sequencer-driven character with a scale track, ribbons from a spline component, gore as a mesh renderer with collision and a blood decal spawned on impact events. Confetti uses a mesh renderer with a flutter drag module.
notes: Two taps print the drum sigil, then the dive is a hip-pivoted arc that shrinks the dancer into the target chest while three silk ribbons trail and then bind the body.
The held beat uses the Uskayaw rhythm: three accelerating heartbeats swell the armour and leak crimson light through noise cracks before the burst.
The burst frame is an eight-point crimson star held for three frames; chunks are wet lit flesh and armour shards on ballistic arcs that bounce and stay.
Silk scraps and brass foil flutter down with drag and sway and settle flat; a wet specular blood pool spreads under the arrival pose.

name: Recall Ancestor
src: Recalls the user's ancestor to their side.
blurb: A lineage sigil roots itself in the floor, grave ash spirals up out of it and settles into the robed shape of the ancestor, who solidifies from the hem upward with a slow amber heart.
port: Niagara: converging particles use a Skeletal Mesh Location target with a lerp-to-target module. The ghost is an overlay material with a height reveal parameter; the sigil is a decal with a radial grow parameter.
notes: The Hepliaklqana language is shared across the three invocations: a verdigris-teal fresnel ghost with memory strata, an amber ember heart, a branching lineage sigil and pale grave ash.
Anticipation is a thread of light from the caster to the sigil while it draws outward ring by ring; ash particles lift from the sigil and converge on points sampled over the body surface.
The reveal is a noise-broken height front that climbs from the robe hem to the crown with a bright band, then a short shaft of light and a ring flash mark the arrival.
Residue is pale rime left in the sigil, ash that keeps shedding from the ghost and a cold mist that pools around its hem.

name: Idealise
src: Fully heals the ancestor and briefly boosts its strength, spellcasting and armour.
blurb: The ember heart of the translucent ancestor swells, then a bright front climbs from hem to crown and leaves it cast in burnished gold with glowing teal lineage engravings and a ring of its line behind its head.
port: Unreal: one material function with a world height reveal parameter drives both the gilded and ghost materials. Flakes are a Niagara emitter spawning at the reveal height on the skeletal mesh surface; the halo is a camera-facing mesh with an SDF ring texture.
notes: Anticipation is the amber heart swelling while memory motes flow in from the caster, the same amber note that sits inside every Hepliaklqana ghost.
The transformation is one height front shared by four layers: the gilded body and robe are alpha clipped below it, the ghost body and robe draw above it, and the front itself burns teal white.
The old ghost skin peels off at the front as pale flakes that drift up; gold dust falls and settles in the sigil afterwards.
The impact is a hard lineage halo ring behind the head held for three frames, which then stays as a dim residual ring while the engravings breathe.

name: Jade serpent
src: Makes the next two moves instant and makes martial attacks during them stronger and unerring.
blurb: A gold-scaled serpent coils up the fighter from heel to crown, cracks forward like a whip, and the fighter takes two instant steps along its line, leaving fading gold afterimages and swirling dust.
port: Niagara ribbon renderer fed by a spline that is animated by one scalar, with a material that builds scales from hex UVs; afterimages are pose-snapshotted skeletal meshes with a fresnel dissolve material.
notes: The serpent is one camera-facing strip with a fake cylindrical normal, so its hex scales are lit as gold metal with ink-dark seams; the head carries two hot eyes.
Its body follows a single path parameter: a tightening helix around the body, then a bezier lash; a lagged tail on the same path makes the whip motion with no simulation.
The whip crack is the impact frame: a bold gold crescent held for three frames with a light pulse, followed by two instant relocations that leave eroding afterimages.
Residue is a brushed enso at the start mark, scuffed dust at each footfall and gold leaf shed by the serpent as it dissolves, which flutters down and lies flat.

name: Heavenly Storm
src: Summons a storm of golden clouds that boosts evasion, accuracy and damage, growing with each martial attack.
blurb: A ring of heavy storm cloud condenses around the fighter and is lit from inside in gold; every strike flashes through it, swells it and adds a stroke to the brushed enso on the floor.
port: Unreal: a heterogeneous volume or a local volumetric fog material on a torus mesh, with a Niagara gold-leaf emitter in a vortex and strike events from the anim notify driving a growth parameter and point light flashes.
notes: The cloud is a raymarched torus of 3D noise, swirled faster near the centre, with one shadow tap toward the inner light and one toward the key so it reads as lit vapour rather than glow.
Growth is literal: each of the three strikes adds radius, height and density to the cloud and extends the brushed enso under the fighter.
Strike beats are gold crescents held for three frames at the fist, spark bursts and a light inside the cloud, so the flash is seen as illumination of the volume.
Gold leaf orbits inside the storm and drifting sparks rise through it; the floor keeps a wind-swept dust spiral.

name: Rising Flame
src: One-time ability: after a short delay the user is blasted upward through the ceiling to the level above.
blurb: The Ignis sigil burns open under the worshipper, fire gathers at their feet and lifts them, then a column of flame fires them straight up through the ceiling, which rains broken stone back down into the smoke.
port: A sequencer shot: a root-motion launch on the character, a Niagara cylinder mesh with an erosion material for the column, and a Chaos or pre-simulated debris cache for the ceiling. The crater is a decal whose emissive cools on a curve.
notes: The delay is the anticipation: the sigil cracks in, flames lick up in a ring, and the body rises half a metre while it shakes before the launch.
The launch is a single bright frame: a hard vertical spike and a floor ring, then a tube of scrolling fire that erodes away from the bottom once the worshipper is gone.
The ceiling is never shown. It is implied by forty instanced rocks that fall from above the frame, bounce once and stay, with a warm shaft of light and dust falling through the hole.
The sigil is left as a cooling crater: glowing cracks under a pale ash lip, with ash drifting down.

name: Bazaar
src: Xom transports a wealthy worshipper to a curious bazaar of amusing wares (0.32+).
blurb: A gilded oval gate unfolds out of Xom’s grin, its parallax interior a lantern-lit market under striped canopies; it drinks the worshipper’s gold, swallows them whole and snaps shut in a spray of confetti.
port: Unreal: interior mapping material on the portal plane (or a scene capture of a small bazaar set), Niagara mesh emitters for coins and confetti with collision and a flutter drag module. The pinch is a scale curve on the character with a radial blur post pass.
notes: The gate interior is one quad that ray-intersects three planes behind itself (lantern strings, striped canopy and stalls, warm haze), so the market has real parallax as the camera moves.
The gold frame carries chasing marquee bulbs for the carnival note; colour stays muted reds, creams and brass rather than neon.
Coins are instanced lit meshes that stream from the body into the gate, and a few are spat back out to tumble, land and lie flat.
The pinch is the impact: the worshipper spins down to nothing in the gate, the grin flashes and paper confetti flutters down onto an oily ring.

name: Supercharge
src: One-time capstone that permanently supercharged a wand or rod.
blurb: The wand rises out of the worshipper’s hands and turns upright over a cog sigil that engraves itself in the floor; a column of blue-white energy slams into it, and it descends forever changed, its brass etched with light.
port: Unreal: a lightning beam system (core ribbon plus branch ribbons) with a short-lived cylinder flash, a floor decal whose engraving mask is revealed by a radial-angle parameter, and a material parameter on the wand for the permanent etch. Pebbles and dust are Niagara mesh and lit sprite emitters.
notes: Anticipation: the wand lifts and stands upright while the cog sigil draws itself into the stone tick by tick and pebbles lift on the static charge.
Impact: a hard white column holds for three frames, then resolves into a few hair-thin jagged bolts and a soft halo that thin out over half a second; a grounding arc runs from the wand to the sigil.
Dust blasts out along the floor and lifted pebbles are thrown and settle; the wand keeps a strong tip glow and newly etched filigree on its brass.
Residue: the sigil stays burned into the floor as charred grooves with a pale ash lip and a faint cooling glow, with smoke curling off it.

name: Wand of Digging
src: Drills a tunnel through rock walls in a line.
blurb: A stubby iron wand tipped with a fluted stone drill bit spins up and throws a grinding bore of grit into a wall of rock; three wall blocks crack and collapse one after another into rubble and hanging dust, leaving a tunnel.
port: Chaos or pre-fractured geometry collections per wall cell triggered in sequence by a line trace, a beam mesh with a scrolling grit material, and Niagara mesh rubble plus six-way lit dust per cell.
notes: The wand is short and heavy on purpose: a leather grip, iron bands and a fluted conical bit whose flutes scroll in the shader while it charges, so it reads as a tool.
The bore is a camera-facing strip whose length is driven by a keyed front: it stalls at each block face, the block lights up with stress cracks, and then the bore pushes through.
Each block is a displaced box that alpha-clips away on a noise threshold in a quarter second while 120 instanced rubble meshes for that block fly, bounce and settle.
Dust is timed per block from one particle layer and lingers, lit by a flickering bore light, and the untouched back row of blocks stays as context for the tunnel.

name: Wand of Disintegration
src: Blasted a target with disintegrating force and, in older versions, destroyed walls (renamed to mindburst in 0.27).
blurb: A square-forged iron wand with a violet crystal claw holds a hair-thin white beam on a masonry wall until a ragged hole crumbles out of it and pours away as fine dust.
port: Unreal: wall as instanced static meshes with a sphere-mask dissolve driven by a material parameter, sand as a Niagara emitter sampling the mask edge, mounds as a world-position-offset mesh scaled by a curve.
notes: The wall is 36 instanced stone blocks. A sphere of erosion grows from the beam point; each fragment is alpha-clipped by triplanar noise against it, with a white-violet cut line that cools to a pale ash lip.
The beam is a two-pixel white core inside a thin violet halo, held for about a second with a sub-frame jitter, so it reads as force rather than fire.
Dust is emitted on the moving erosion front and falls as a sand stream; two lathe mounds grow at the wall foot as it lands.
The wand is a four-sided lathe (square section) in blackened iron with a violet crystal; its rune band charges before the shot.

name: Phial of Floods
src: Unleashes a torrent of water that smashes the target, floods the area with shallow water and waterlogs air-breathers so they cannot cast spells.
blurb: A stoppered blue phial is uncorked and a torrent far larger than the bottle hammers the target, then spreads into a rippling shallow flood.
port: Niagara ribbon or a spline mesh with a panning water material for the jet, a mesh renderer for the droplets, and a deferred decal with animated normal maps for the flood.
notes: The phial is a lathe flask with an alpha glass shell over a sloshing liquid core; the cork pops off on a ballistic arc and stays where it lands.
The torrent is a lathe tube bent along a bezier in the vertex shader. Its radius swells from the neck to the target, so it reads as impossibly large for the bottle.
Water is shaded from the stage environment and the effect lights with a fresnel term, flowing normals and foam, never as an emissive fill.
The flood is a ground decal with expanding ripple normals and caustic light. It drains through a noise threshold and leaves dark wet patches with a specular sheen.

name: Tin of Tremorstones
src: Releases dormant earth elementals as heavy pebbles that land near monsters and explode in several rock-fragment blasts.
blurb: A dented tin flips open and spills five vein-lit pebbles that land around two foes, wake one after another and burst into tumbling shrapnel and dust.
port: Niagara: a launcher emitter spawning five mesh particles with collision events, each firing a mesh shrapnel burst and a six-way lit dust burst; craters as decals spawned from the same events.
notes: The tin is a lathe cup with a hinged lid rotated in the vertex shader around its rim; the inside glows and lights the hand while the stones stir.
Each pebble is an instanced rock on its own lobbed arc with a short skid, its cracks pulsing faster until it detonates on its own beat.
One shrapnel layer serves all five blasts: every instance picks its pebble from its index, then follows a closed-form arc with one bounce and stays where it lands.
Dust and craters are timed per pebble from the cast age, so the area fills with overlapping rings of lit dust and pale-lipped pits.

name: Figurine of a Ziggurat
src: Evoked to create a portal to a ziggurat.
blurb: A palm-sized stepped figurine of sandstone and gold is tossed onto the floor, where its blocks swell one by one into a towering stepped gate whose doorway opens on a burning sky and a distant ziggurat.
port: Instanced static meshes with a growth timeline per instance (or a Niagara mesh emitter with per-particle delays), a portal material using a camera-vector cubemap or render target, and burst dust emitters per block.
notes: The figurine and the gate are the same fifteen instanced box blocks. Each one interpolates from its figurine-scale position to its full-size position on its own delay with an overshoot, so the gate builds itself from the base up.
Blocks are weathered sandstone from a triplanar noise with carved grooves and a gold inlay border that wakes up as each block lands.
The doorway is a quad that renders a view along the camera ray into another place: a banded ember sky, stars and a stepped ziggurat silhouette with parallax, edged by a crackling rim.
Every block sheds lit grit as it grows, the base throws a ring of dust when it lands, and the portal light warms the floor and the caster.

name: Lamp of Fire
src: Fired several trails of flame in a direction, leaving burning clouds (earlier it summoned fire elementals; removed in 0.25).
blurb: A brass oil lamp is tipped forward and pours a tongue of fire onto the floor that splits into three snaking trails, each leaving rolling clouds of flame, smoke and a scorched track.
port: Niagara: three spline-following spawners with a moving head distance, each leaving a grid of short-lived looping fire emitters. The decal is a deferred decal reading a baked trail mask, the lamp a static mesh with a socket for the pour.

name: Rod of Lightning
src: Cast Thunderbolt, a cone-shaped lightning arc that could be sustained (replaced by the lightning rod in 0.20).
blurb: A copper coil rod crackles between its three prongs, then holds open a fan of white lightning that rakes the target and the floor, leaving branching scorch and ozone smoke.
port: Niagara ribbon renderer with a beam emitter per fork and a noise module at 25 Hz. The scorch is a decal with an emissive cooling curve; the strobe is a light function on two point lights.
notes: The rod is a lathe with a procedurally ridged copper coil, a wooden grip and a glass bulb; three instanced box prongs splay from the head.
The fan is fourteen instanced ribbons. Each bolt has a hair thin white core and a faint tinted halo, and its jagged path reseeds every 40 ms so the sheet stutters.
The sustained beat drives a strobing light at the target and at the floor, so the whole room flickers blue-white.
Residue is a Lichtenberg scorch fan whose branches cool from tint to soot, plus thin smoke rising from the floor strikes and the prongs.

name: Rod of Inaccuracy
src: Fired a very powerful but very inaccurate bolt (rods removed in 0.20).
blurb: A crooked, trembling rod with a cracked geode head spits a fat white-violet bolt that weaves wildly around the target, misses entirely and craters the floor beside it.
port: Niagara: the bolt is a particle following a spline with a curl noise offset, the contrail a ribbon with a lifetime-driven erosion material. The crater is a decal with an emissive mask.
notes: The rod is a lathe bent in the vertex shader into a gnarled crooked branch; its geode head is a rock mesh with violet veins that sputter during the tell.
The bolt follows a shaped noise path between the rod and the miss point; a lingering lit smoke contrail records the whole erratic route.
The miss lands with a two frame spiked flash, forty instanced rock chunks on ballistic arcs and a lit dust cloud.
Residue is a cracked crater with cooling violet veins, the hanging contrail and the untouched target turning toward the blast.

name: Deck of Cards
src: Physical decks (escape, destruction, summoning, war, wonders, etc.) evoked to draw a card with a random effect; decks became Nemelex-only abilities in 0.23.
blurb: A gilt-edged deck fans five ghost cards, one real card flips out of it, grows in the air, shows its burning sigil and is consumed, and the sigil is hammered into the floor in a column of gold-violet fire.
port: Unreal: the card is a skeletal mesh with a burn dissolve driven by a Dynamic Material Instance; ash is a Niagara mesh emitter of paper flakes with drag. The sigil is a decal with an emissive cooling curve.
notes: The deck is a box mesh with a lacquered red back, gilt edges and stacked page lines on the sides; the drawn card is a thin box with a painted ivory face.
The random draw is shown by five spectral cards fanning above the deck before one solid card leaves it.
The card burns with an alpha-clip erosion from its edges, an ember rim and paper ash chips that tumble and drift down.
The effect lands as a flame column and a branded sigil decal that keeps a cooling glow, with lit smoke rolling off the floor.

name: Staff of Olgreb
src: Can be evoked to cast Olgreb's Toxic Radiance, continuously poisoning everything in line of sight.
blurb: A staff wound with a carved bronze serpent strikes the floor, and sickly radiance rolls out in waves that raise poison blisters on everyone in sight.
port: Unreal: the coil is baked into the staff mesh. Radiance waves are a floor decal and a sphere with a fresnel material driven by a pulse curve; blisters are a Niagara skeletal-mesh-surface emitter on each victim.

name: Hell Rift
blurb: A jagged tear in the air that splits open onto a burning world, sheds embers and scorches the floor beneath it.
port: One masked translucent quad with the rift SDF baked to a texture and a width parameter driven by a timeline curve. Interior parallax is a BumpOffset node. Embers are a Niagara emitter that samples the same spine curve.
notes: The silhouette is a distance field around a piecewise-linear zigzag spine. Each side gets its own width noise, then a noise threshold breaks the edge.
Three beats: a hairline slit races up and down, the tear snaps open with overshoot and an ember burst, then it pinches shut along the same spine.
The interior is sampled with a view-dependent offset at two depths, so the fire sky slides behind the lava veins when the camera moves.
Edge licks are scrolling noise eroded by distance to the tear, which keeps the hottest values pinned to the crack line.
Embers spawn on the spine and pour out of both faces. The floor gets a fissure decal, a light pool and two point lights.

name: Void Gate
blurb: A rune-cut stone arch holding a membrane that is a real window: stars, a nebula and an eclipsed sun shift behind it as the camera moves.
port: Unreal: the arch is a static mesh with an emissive rune mask. The membrane is an unlit material that feeds the camera vector into a cubemap or star texture lookup, plus two BumpOffset layers for the debris.
notes: The membrane never samples its own UVs for the far world. It projects the view ray through the quad, so the sky behaves like a place at infinity.
Drifting rock silhouettes are intersected at two finite depths behind the surface. They slide faster than the stars, which is what sells the depth.
The arch is one torus mesh reshaped in the vertex shader into legs, capitals, plinths and a keystone with a square section, then flat shaded and lit.
Runes are carved per stone block from the same block id that draws the mortar joints, and a slow wave of light travels around the arch.
A thin film of noise, a fresnel sheen and a little refraction keep the surface readable as a membrane and not as a hole.

name: Ice Mirror
blurb: A frozen oval mirror grows out of the floor, glazes over with cracked ice that reflects a cold sky, and spreads frost and fog across the ground.
port: Mirror: a translucent material with a shard normal map, a cubemap reflection and refraction. Frost: a decal with a radius parameter driving a noise threshold. Frame and shards are static meshes with a subsurface ice material.
notes: The surface is split into Voronoi shards warped around an impact point. Each shard gets its own tilted normal, so the fake sky reflection breaks at every crack and jumps as the camera moves.
The reflection is a small procedural environment (horizon glow, aurora, a hard moon highlight) sampled with the reflected view vector, not a screen copy.
Frozen inclusions are sampled at two parallax depths and the shard normals also write to the distortion buffer, which gives the ice thickness.
The frame is a torus pushed into spikes in the vertex shader and flat shaded. Floor frost is a noise-thresholded front that only grows, with a brighter crystalline leading edge.
Orbiting shards are faceted sprite diamonds, kept few and slow so the mirror stays the primary read.

name: Fireball
src: Hurls a fireball that explodes, dealing fire damage in a small radius burst.
blurb: A dense coal of flame is lobbed in a high arc, bursts against the target as a tight, self-shadowed fireball and leaves small fires burning on a cracked scorch.
port: Niagara: a projectile emitter on a spline with a collision event. The blast is a baked VDB or flipbook with temperature and density channels and 6-way lighting; floor fires are a small looping emitter spawned at decal points.
notes: The blast is a raymarched volume bounded to one tile: 3D Worley billows inside a sphere, with one shadow tap toward the key light so the soot cap has a lit side and a dark underside.
Unlike a straight bolt, the projectile is lobbed on a quadratic arc with a corkscrew of sparks and a thin soot thread, so the travel beat reads as a throw.
The impact frame is a hard ring with four short spikes held for three frames; after that the point light carries the scale.
Residue: a scorch with an ash lip and cooling cracks, burning spatter that keeps licking the floor, and a charred patch on the target.

name: Boiling Blood
src: Allies in an area gain bonus damage on their fire and physical attacks for several turns.
blurb: A thrown splash of blood spreads into a dark pool beneath three allies, then boils: bubbles swell and burst, veins of heat light up their armour and steam rolls off their shoulders.
port: A decal with a flow-mapped normal and a sphere-mask spread parameter. Bubbles are a Niagara mesh emitter, veins a material layer on the character with a pulse curve, steam a lit flipbook emitter skinned to the body.
notes: The pool is a wet decal, not a glow: dark albedo, a reflective specular term from env(), and ripple normals driven by the bubble field so the key light catches the surface.
Bubbles are instanced hemispheres that swell, wobble and pop on their own cycle, each pop throwing a few lit droplets.
The buff reads on the bodies: a shell over each ally draws pulsing veins and a wet sheen, beating on a shared heartbeat that also drives the light.
Restraint: the only saturated value is the vein heat; blood, steam and the floor stay dark and physical.

name: Blazerip
src: Deals arcane and fire damage in a wide line perpendicular to the caster and melts walls.
blurb: A violet seam is scribed across the floor, tears open into a fissure full of arcane dark, and a curtain of fire roars up along its length, slumping a stone wall into glowing slag.
port: A spline decal for the fissure with a bump-offset interior, a curtain mesh with a two-tone flame material, and a vertex-animated or Chaos-melted wall mesh with a temperature parameter. Niagara handles embers and smoke along the spline.
notes: Seen over the shoulder, so the perpendicular line spans the frame. The tell is a thin violet seam racing outward both ways from the caster aim point.
The fissure is a floor decal with a parallax interior: noise sampled along the view ray makes the rift look deep, with stars of arcane light far below.
The fire curtain is a vertical subdivided sheet with eroding flame that starts violet at the root and burns orange above, the two damage types in one gradient.
The wall is eight lit stone blocks that heat through a blackbody ramp and sag in the vertex shader into a slag heap that keeps glowing as the fissure cools to a seam.

name: Holy Fire
src: Deals fire and holy damage in a cross pattern and stuns.
blurb: A thread of white light drops onto the target, then a cross splits the floor: one arm runs as a wall of flame, the other rises as blades of light, and the victim reels under a ring of sparks.
port: Two Niagara ribbon or sprite emitters driven by one front-distance curve, one cross-shaped decal with two material layers for char and bleach, and a camera-facing card row for the light blades. The stun ring is a small orbit emitter attached to the head socket.
notes: Tell: a single falling thread of light and a faint cross etched into the flagstones while the caster hand charges.
Impact: a tapered plus held for three frames, then both arms race outward on easeOutExpo from the target tile.
The fire arm is upward-stretched flame streaks with dark lit smoke. The holy arm is a row of camera-facing light blades, tallest at the centre, so the cross reads from the side as well as from above.
Residue differs per arm: the fire arm leaves charred stone with a pale ash lip and embers, the holy arm leaves bleached stone with gold seams that cool.

name: Shrapnel Blast
src: Detonates a wall, dealing fire damage nearby and shooting shards that deal physical damage to random tiles.
blurb: A brick wall glows at the mortar and bulges, then blows apart in a ball of fire that fires iron and stone splinters across the room, where they stick in the floor still glowing.
port: Fractured wall mesh with per-brick dissolve, a Niagara mesh emitter for the shards with a collision event that spawns spark and dust bursts and freezes each shard in place, and lit flipbooks for fire and smoke.
notes: Tell: heat finds the mortar first. The joints glow from the centre outward while the face bulges along its normal and the wall trembles.
Impact: bricks are clipped away per brick id above a ragged stump line, so the break follows the masonry. The torn inside shows a hot core.

Shards are 110 instanced lit splinters on straight, fast arcs to random tiles. They bury themselves at their flight angle, each landing throws its own sparks and dust, and the tips cool from white to dull red.
Residue: a soot fan in front of the stump, fallen bricks, embedded shards and a smoke column lit from below.

name: Fiery Tormentor
src: Summons a tormentor demon with a fire burst and a soul-draining attack.
blurb: The floor splits into a ring of fire and a legless horned demon of cracked basalt hauls itself up out of the eruption, throws off a shell of flame, then reaches for the nearest foe and pulls its pale soul out through the air.
port: Skeletal mesh demon with a lava-crack emissive parameter, a Niagara fire wreath attached to sockets, a sphere mesh with an erosion material for the burst, and beam emitters with a flow texture for the soul drain.
notes: The demon is one solid raymarched SDF: chest, belly and a tapering bezier tail instead of legs, horns swept back, and two arms that blend between rest, a flung-open nova pose and a one-armed reach.
Its fire burst is an eroding sphere shell rather than a floor ring, so it reads differently from the other novas in the collection.
The soul drain is three wispy ribbons in a cold second colour, flowing toward the open maw, with motes peeling off the victim, who sags forward.
Residue: a cracked eruption ring with an ash lip and small fires, embers rising through the flame wreath and smoke above it.

name: Fire Drake
src: Summons a flying fire drake with a fire breath cone.
blurb: A ring of fire tears open in the air and a lean red drake beats its way out of it, hangs on flapping wings, lowers its head and pours a cone of fire across the floor onto the enemy below.
port: Skeletal mesh drake with a hover-flap loop and a breath montage, a Niagara cone emitter on a mouth socket with collision-spawned ground fires, and a scorch decal projected along the breath direction.
notes: The drake is a lean SDF: a body ellipsoid, a bezier neck that dips for the breath, a horned head with a hinged jaw, a whip tail and two membrane wings built from triangle distances with finger bones.

The wings flap on one sine shared with a small body bob, rotating the whole wing frame about the body axis. The membranes take extra light from the effect lights so they glow red when the breath fires.

The breath is a lathe cone with scrolling flame noise and a soft-particle core of tongues, aimed from the mouth to the target. The mouth point is computed in JS with the same transform for the cone and the lights.
Residue: a fan-shaped scorch where the cone met the floor, a few burning patches, the target smouldering, and smoke drifting up through the wing beats.

name: Icicle
src: Launches an icicle dealing physical and ice damage to the target and adjacent tiles.
blurb: A spinning icicle condenses out of a ring of rime above the hand, drills into the target and splits into ice spikes that burst out of the eight surrounding tiles.
port: Niagara mesh projectile with a collision event. The tile eruption is a second mesh emitter spawning from a 3 by 3 grid location module with a per-ring delay. Rime is a deferred decal plus a material layer blend on the target.
notes: Anticipation is accretion: motes spiral inward and the icicle grows while spinning, then recoils a hand width before launch.
The splash is the hook. The tile grid around the target erupts in leaning crystal clusters, staggered by distance so the cold reads as spreading outward.
Shards and frost mist are lit by the stage key and the cold impact light. Mist sinks and creeps along the floor instead of rising.
Residue is physical: crystal clusters stay standing, a square rime decal follows the tile layout and the chest plate is frosted where it hit.

name: Volcanic Eruption
src: Turns the ground to lava chasm and deals fire damage in a large burst.
blurb: The floor cracks and heaves, then blows apart: slabs tumble away, a fountain of lava bombs arcs out and splats, and a crusted chasm is left breathing under a column of smoke.
port: Niagara: mesh emitters for slabs and bombs with collision and a scalar cooling parameter, a lit smoke emitter with six-way flipbooks, and a lava decal with a flow-mapped voronoi crust. The tell is a material parameter on the floor decal.
notes: Anticipation is the ground itself. Radial cracks glow from below, slabs tremble and lift, and steam leaks from the seams.
Lava bombs are 60 instanced lit spheres on ballistic arcs. Each one squashes into a splat where it lands and cools from orange to crust over two seconds.
The chasm is a voronoi crust floating on a molten field; plate edges glow and the plates drift slowly so the pool reads as liquid.
Smoke is dark, heavy and lit from underneath by the pool light, so its belly is orange and its top falls into the room ambient.

name: Bloodflame
src: For one turn, your fire spells cast instantly but each spell cast burns you and you lose fire resistance.
blurb: Blood beads through the joints of the armour on three heartbeats, then catches: the caster burns in dark crimson fire that streams from both hands and drips onto the floor.
port: Niagara skeletal mesh location emitter for the body fire, two socket emitters on the hands, and a collision event for drips that spawns decal splats. The veins are a material layer on the character with a heartbeat curve.
notes: Anticipation is a heartbeat. Three thuds pulse the vein overlay and the light, and glossy blood beads well up on the body and start to run.
Ignition is one frame of a dark spiked silhouette with a hot rim behind the caster, then the fire belongs to the body: particles are emitted from the mannequin surface and the raised arms.
The fire is dark on purpose. A blood tint through flame() keeps the core pale but the body deep red, and black smoke with a red underside takes light away.
Self harm reads through residue: burning drops fall from the hands and leave wet red splats with a specular sheen, and the armour veins keep glowing.

name: Rain of Fire
src: Channeled: each turn casts your Fireball on many random tiles in a large radius.
blurb: Thirty-six fireballs come down almost vertically across a wide field, one every eighth of a second, until the floor is pocked with smouldering scorch rings under a low ceiling of smoke.
port: Niagara: one emitter that spawns a fireball every tick at a random point in a disc, reusing the Fireball system through an event. Scorches go to a decal pool. Light budget is handled by only letting the newest three impacts spawn lights.
notes: The read is density and rhythm, not one big blast. Every fireball is the same small spell, so the eye counts them landing and the floor keeps score.
Every layer is a single burst where each particle picks one of 36 impacts and times itself from it, so heads, trails, blasts, smoke and embers stay in sync without 36 emitters.
The floor decal loops over every impact: a two-frame shock ring, then a scorch with a pale ash lip and an ember core that cools at its own rate.
The three most recent impacts drive the stage lights, so the columns and smoke flicker unevenly the way a real barrage would light a room.

name: Iceball
src: Deals ice damage in a radius burst and freezes units hit.
blurb: A packed ball of hail is lobbed into the middle of two enemies and bursts into a crown of ice spikes that races outward, glazes them to the waist and leaves the floor bristling.
port: Niagara: projectile with a ribbon-free puff trail, a collision event that spawns a mesh emitter of spikes (scale curve, radial delay), mesh chunks with collision, and a six-way lit smoke burst. The freeze is a character overlay material driven by height.
notes: The ball is a lumpy displaced sphere with snow-white rime and a faint glow in its cracks, shedding a lit vapour wake on a lob.
The impact is a hard ring held for two frames, a hemisphere of lit cold vapour and forty ice spikes that fire outward in a wave, tilted away from the centre.
Both enemies are frozen by a shell whose front climbs from the boots to the chest as the wave passes them.
Residue is the spike crown, scattered ice chunks that bounced and settled, and a radial frost decal under everything.

name: Wall of Ice
src: Summons a line of ice elementals perpendicular to the caster.
blurb: A frost seam runs out from the caster and splits into a line across the room, and five hunched ice elementals heave up out of it crystal by crystal, open their eyes together and stand guard.
port: Production would use one skeletal elemental mesh with a growth mask, spawned five times along a spline. The seam is a decal with a reveal parameter, and the crystal assembly ports to a Niagara mesh emitter sampling a static mesh with per-particle delays.
notes: Each elemental is eighteen instanced crystals from a part table: legs, hips, torso, chest plates, shoulders, arms, fists, head, crown and back spikes, ninety in all.
The seam is a decal: a jagged crack runs from the caster to the wall line in a few frames, then tears both ways along it, glowing while the bodies grow out of it.
Growth is staggered from the centre outward and from the feet up, each crystal overshooting as it locks. The shared eye ignition is the impact frame, with a hard flash at each head.
Residue is the cooled seam with a rime border, chips shed during the climb and cold vapour that keeps rolling off the line while the elementals idle.

name: Lightning Bolt
src: Deals lightning damage to every unit in a beam.
blurb: A straight, braided beam leaves the hand and skewers three foes in a row, raking the floor with forks that leave a dotted line of fused, smoking pits.
port: Niagara beam emitter between two sockets with low jitter and two extra ribbon strands. Ground forks are a line trace sampled along the beam that spawns short beams and decals. Target vein flashes are a material parameter pulse on the character overlay.

name: Thunder Strike
src: Deals heavy lightning damage to a target and stuns enemies in a small radius.
blurb: The room dims, streamers reach up off the target's helmet, and a thick stroke drops out of the dark, blasting a crater fringed with a pale fern of fused stone while the neighbours twitch with stun.
port: Niagara: leader and return stroke as beam emitters on one cached spline, lit with a strong point light keyed to the stroke curve. The Lichtenberg figure is a deferred decal using a log-polar crack texture with an emissive cooling ramp. Debris is a mesh emitter with collision.

name: Magnetize
src: Magnetizes a metallic unit so nearby enemies are pulled toward it each turn and stunned/shocked when adjacent.
blurb: A spark lands on an armoured foe and iron filings in the dust snap into its field; scrap slides in and clings, two enemies are dragged across the floor, and the moment they touch it they are shocked rigid.
port: Niagara: filings are a mesh emitter on a grid whose orientation is sampled from a vector field (a dipole formula or a baked VectorField asset). Enemy pull is gameplay; drag trails are decals spawned per footstep. Field loops are ribbon emitters along analytic splines.

name: Conductance
src: Curses a target to lose lightning resistance and to have lightning spells cast on it copied.
blurb: A copper filament spools from the caster and winds itself tight around the foe, so when lightning finds it the coil rings and throws the strike down a second time.
port: Spline mesh or a ribbon along a helix spline for the coil, with a grow parameter on its material. Strikes are beam emitters triggered twice from one event, and the burn is a decal with a temperature scalar.

name: Lightning Storm
src: Creates storm clouds over an area that randomly strike units with lightning.
blurb: A low ceiling of thundercloud rolls together over the room, rain starts to fall, and bolts drop at random, two of them finding heads and three leaving glassy pits in the wet stone.
port: Volumetric cloud as a local fog volume or a raymarched mesh material. Strikes are beam emitters fired from a random-location spawner on a timer, each with a light, a decal and a chip burst. Rain is a GPU sprite emitter with a wetness parameter on the floor material.

name: Storm Drake
src: Summons a flying storm drake that breathes lightning and leaves storm clouds.
blurb: A slate-grey drake tears out of a knot of thundercloud, beats down to a hover trailing vapour from its wingtips, and opens its jaw to rake a foe with a stuttering lance of lightning.
port: A skinned drake mesh with a flap loop and a breath montage; wingtip sockets drive a ribbon or sprite emitter of lit cloud. The breath is a beam emitter from a jaw socket with an event-driven restrike curve.

name: Watcher Form
src: Transform into an immobile watcher that fires a lightning beam at the farthest enemy each turn.
blurb: A cracked stone husk grinds up around the caster and seals over its head, then splits open on one wet, slit-pupilled eye that searches the room, ignores the nearest foe and burns a beam into the farthest.
port: Stone shell as a static mesh with a rise timeline and crack emissive; eye as a separate mesh with an iris material and an animated lid mask. The beam is a Niagara beam with a persistent core and short-lived jagged ribbons.

name: Rain of Thunderbolts
src: Channeled: each turn casts your Thunder Strike on many random storm clouds, prioritising those with enemies.
blurb: The caster drags a low bank of storm cloud over the room and holds it there while seven heavy strokes hammer down one after another, each one lighting the cloud from inside and kicking up stone and dust.
port: One Niagara system with a timeline emitter that spawns strike events at cloud positions; each event drives a beam, a mesh rubble burst with collision and a decal. Clouds are lit six-way flipbook sprites with an emissive parameter from the strike events.
notes: The cloud bank is a field of lit puffs at ceiling height. Each strike adds light inside the nearest puffs, so the clouds flash from within before the floor does.
Seven strikes on a fixed timeline, three of them on the two foes. Every strike has its own seed so the channels never repeat, and the lights follow the three most recent.
A thin flickering tether runs from the raised hands into the cloud for as long as the channel holds. When it drops, the bank thins and drifts.
Residue per strike: a crater decal that cools from blackbody orange to a soot ring with a pale lip, ten lit rubble chips that bounce and stay, and a puff of stone dust.

name: Rain Storm
src: Creates a rain storm area; units inside are Soaked (lower ice/lightning resist, higher fire resist).
blurb: A tight black squall spins down over one target, drops a wind-driven sheet of rain that hits the floor as a ring of spray, and leaves the victim streaming water in spreading puddles.
port: Niagara: a spawn-in-cylinder rain emitter with wind, a collision event spawning splash sprites, and a localized volumetric cloud (or a swirled flipbook card stack). Wetness is a material parameter on the character and a puddle decal with a ripple normal flipbook.
notes: Tell: a low, slowly turning disc of cloud gathers over the target from nothing; its density is a swirled 3D Perlin-Worley field with a shadow tap, and a negative light under it darkens the area.
Impact: the first sheet of rain lands as one hard white spray ring on the floor, held for three frames.
The downpour is slanted by wind: stretched streak particles, faint billboarded curtains, splash crowns on the floor and low spray that is lit by the room.
Residue: the victim gets a wet specular shell with water sheeting down and dripping off the arms, and puddles with ripples keep spreading after the rain eases.

name: Prison of Thorns
src: Surrounds a group of enemies with thorny plants that block and prick them.
blurb: A fistful of seeds scatters around a knot of enemies, and two dozen briar canes whip up out of the cracked stone and arch over them into a hooked, thorned cage.
port: Spline meshes driven by a growth parameter in a material (world position offset along the spline), or Niagara ribbon meshes. Thorns are instanced static meshes placed along the spline at authoring time and scaled in by the same parameter.
notes: Tell: twelve seeds leave the caster’s hand on ballistic arcs and wink in the floor in a rough ring around the targets.
Impact: a hard ring flashes for three frames and every cane erupts on its own bezier path with an exponential whip, overshoot and settle. Short canes thicken the base.
Each cane is an instanced tube bent along a cubic curve with a growth parameter, so it extends from the tip. Three hundred cone thorns ride the same curves, popping out as the tip passes.
Residue: a torn soil ring with a pale lip, settled grit and leaves, and tiny blood flecks where the thorns caught the enemies, who flinch back.

name: Blue Lion
src: Summons a blue lion that melee attacks and grants shields to allies.
blurb: Stars prick out of the dark one by one and the caster draws them together into the outline of a lion; the constellation falls to the floor and a heavy blue-grey lion with a mane full of night sky stands up out of it and wards its summoner.
port: A lion skeletal mesh with a two-part material: fur and a mane that samples a cube-mapped star field in view space. The constellation is a Niagara ribbon system with points spawned in order; the shield is a sphere with a fresnel and depth-fade material.
notes: Tell: fourteen stars light in sequence and hair-thin lines join them into a lion constellation, so the summon is readable before any matter exists.
Impact: a hard ring and a cold flash, then the solid raymarched lion is revealed nose to tail through a starlit noise edge while the constellation points sink into it.
The body is smooth-min ellipsoids and capsules with a short-fur normal break-up and sheen. The mane is a separate noisy ellipsoid whose material is a parallax star field with slow nebula noise.
Last beat: the lion lifts its head and a thread of starlight arcs to the caster, whose shield blooms as a thin fresnel shell. Starlit dust settles as residue.

name: Spider Queen
src: Summons a spider queen that lays eggs hatching into spiders.
blurb: A silk-lined burrow opens in the flagstones, lines shoot up into the dark, and a bloated banded queen hooks her legs over the rim and hauls herself out, then squeezes glistening egg sacs onto the floor, the first of which splits and spills spiderlings.
port: A skeletal spider with IK feet locked to the rim of a burrow decal and a climb-out montage. Egg sacs are spawned meshes with a split blend shape; spiderlings are a Niagara mesh emitter with a random-walk velocity and floor collision.
notes: Tell: a funnel web spreads around a black burrow and anchor lines shoot up into the vault, so the space is claimed before the creature arrives.

The queen is a solid raymarched body with mirrored legs, each a femur and tibia capsule with the foot pinned to the floor, so she climbs out of the hole: legs first, then the body, then the swollen abdomen. The stage floor depth hides everything still below ground.
Chitin is near-black and glossy with bone-coloured chevrons and a noise normal for bristles; the eye cluster catches the tint light.
Egg sacs are instanced spheres with wound silk shading laid from the spinneret on arcs; the first one splits and instanced spiderlings scuttle out in jittery bursts and stay.

name: Dragon Roar
src: All allied dragons gain max HP, damage and breath cooldown resets for many turns.
blurb: The caster bellows a draconic roar that rolls across the floor as a cone of pressure and blown dust; it slams into an allied drake, ember-red veins crack open through its scales from the chest outward, and the drake rears and answers with a column of fire.
port: A dragon skeletal mesh with an emissive crack layer driven by a sphere-mask parameter, a roar montage, and Niagara for the cone (mesh arcs plus a ribbon dust sheet), the fire column (sprite fire with smoke sub-emitter) and an ember aura parented to the spine.
notes: Tell and impact are the caster: an inhale that pulls grit in, then a forward lean and three pressure arcs that travel the floor with distortion and drive a sheet of lit dust toward the dragon.
The drake is one solid raymarched body: smooth-min ellipsoids for torso and chest, capsule neck, legs and tail, folded wing membranes and a head whose jaw opens on its answering roar.
The buff is shown in the material: a crack mask is revealed by distance from the chest as the wave arrives, glowing with a blackbody ramp mixed toward the tint, then breathing on a slow pulse.
The breath cooldown reset is the payoff: a short flame column with real smoke, embers that rise off the back for the rest of the effect, and soot settling.

name: Moorland Ground Fog
blurb: Knee-high fog rolls across the floor, glows warm around a torch and catches cool moonlight shafts.
port: Unreal: Exponential Height Fog with Volumetric Fog enabled, a local fog volume material using the same two noise octaves, and a point light with volumetric scattering raised. The shaft mask becomes a light function on the directional light.
notes: One ray layer marches the fog and a thin haze above it. The march stops at the scene depth, so the mannequin and stones cut clean holes in it.
Density is two octaves of the 3D noise texture pushed by wind, minus a height gradient, which gives a rolling top instead of a flat sheet.
The torch is a real effect light. The fog samples it per step with fxLight, so the warm halo and the lit floor always agree.
Moonlight shafts are a 2D noise mask projected along the key light direction. The haze makes them visible as beams before they reach the fog.
Steps are spaced tighter near the camera and jittered per pixel, which trades banding for fine grain.

name: Cathedral God Rays
blurb: Shafts of light fall through gaps in an unseen roof, pool on the floor and light up drifting dust.
port: Unreal: a directional or spot light with a light function material for the gaps and volumetric fog for the shafts. Dust is a Niagara emitter whose material samples the same light function in world space.
notes: A single mask function projects any world point along the light direction and tests it against a handful of roof gaps, warped and streaked with the noise sheet.
The ray layer integrates that mask along each view ray. A forward-scattering phase function makes shafts brighter when you look toward the light.
The floor pools, the light on the mannequin and the dust motes all call the same mask, so every element agrees about where the light is.
The mannequin casts a soft analytic shadow into the shafts and onto the floor, which ties the character to the light.
Motes are nearly invisible in shade and flare inside a shaft. That contrast is what sells the volume.

name: Night Rain
blurb: Cold rain falls in depth layers onto wet stone. A lantern catches the drops and distant lightning lights the sky.
port: Niagara: GPU sprites with velocity alignment for near rain and a camera-facing cylinder with a panning streak texture for far rain. Ripples are a flipbook normal decal blended into the wet surface layer.
notes: Rain is two particle layers at different distances plus a scrolling streak sheet for the far field, which is cheaper than more particles.
Every drop is timed to reach the floor exactly at the end of its life, so nothing pops out in mid air.
Splash rings are flat particles. The wet sheen layer rebuilds the stage puddle mask and adds ripple normals from a cell-based ring function.
Drops, rings and the sheen all read the lantern through fxLight, so rain near the lantern turns warm and the floor shows a long reflection.
The distant flash is a huge far light plus a sky glow, with a flicker and an echo strike.

name: Dispersion Field
src: Buff: each turn teleports several nearby enemies to random locations.
blurb: A barely visible dome of bent space sits around the caster; when it flexes, each foe inside is sliced into sliding bands, pinched to a seam and dropped somewhere across the room in a burst of its own dust.
port: A translucent dome material with scene-colour refraction around the player, an ability tick that queues enemies by distance, and a world-position-offset material function that bands and pinches the enemy mesh before the teleport, with Niagara dust bursts and decals at both ends.
notes: The field is a dome that only shows as refraction and a faint fresnel skin, with dust motes slowly orbiting inside it, so the buff reads at rest without a glowing bubble.
Each turn the dome flexes and a hard ring runs across the floor; the departure time of each foe comes from its distance to the caster, so the wave visibly causes the jumps.
Foes are an instanced mannequin layer. The vertex shader shears alternate horizontal bands sideways and then pinches the body to a vertical seam, and the cut lines carry the only violet light.
Residue at both ends: a scoured pale ring where each foe stood and a settling dust ring where it landed, both lit by short effect lights.

name: Void Drake
src: Summons a flying void drake whose arcane breath melts walls.
blurb: Obsidian shards climb out of a crack in the floor and lock together into a black glass drake whose wings are windows onto a starfield; it hangs on slow beats and breathes a sputtering stream of void that slumps a stone wall into dripping violet glass.
port: Skeletal drake with an emissive seam mask and a scene-texture starfield on the wing membrane material, a Niagara shard convergence emitter for the summon, a breath beam plus smoke emitter on a mouth socket, and a wall mesh with a world-position-offset melt mask and a drip emitter that spawns puddle decals.
notes: Summon: a jagged rift opens in the flagstones, instanced obsidian shards rise and converge, and the raymarched body materialises through a noise mask while its plate seams burn bright and cool.
The body is glossy black glass with faceted plates from 3D voronoi and a thin violet rim; the wing membranes show a parallax starfield, which separates this drake from the fire, ice and storm drakes.
The breath is not a cone: a tight, flickering core thread wrapped in dark void smoke and violet motes, aimed at a wall rather than a foe, matching the wall-melting rule.
The wall is a subdivided box whose vertices slump inward and sag downward around the impact; it glows, drips violet glass that pools at its base, then cools to a glossy dark scar.

name: Lifedrain
src: Curses a target to take dark damage each turn for many turns, healing the caster for the same amount.
blurb: A thorn of curse light brands the victim, then on every turn the curse wrings a clot of blood out of the body and lobs it across the room into the caster, spattering the floor along the arc.
port: Niagara: the clot is a mesh particle on a projectile path with child droplet emitters that spawn decals on collision. The thorn sigil is a decal with an emissive mask pulsed by a turn event, and the victim pall is a material parameter on the character.
notes: Built as three beats that repeat, one per game turn: the victim flinches, blood beads out of the armour and gathers into a trembling clot, and the clot is thrown on a true ballistic arc into the caster chest.
The clot is a displaced sphere with a wet blood material: dark albedo, tight specular, environment reflection and a thin warm scatter at grazing angles.
Droplets that shed from the clot in flight fall under gravity, and the floor spatter decal uses the same closed-form landing points, so every stain lines up with a falling drop.
The caster gets a warm heartbeat pulse on each catch while the victim slowly greys under an accumulating pall. A thorned sigil under the victim marks the curse for its whole duration.

name: Hollow Flesh
src: Curses living units to become undead, losing max HP and resistances and unable to heal.
blurb: A ring of black thorns closes on a living warrior, the warmth is torn out of them in one amber breath, and grey rot eats holes through the armour until the bones show inside a hollow, walking husk.
port: Character material with a rot mask spreading from a socket, opacity-masked holes over a separate inner skeleton mesh and a world-position offset for the shrink. The life burst is a Niagara emitter in a warm palette with a short curl force; the stain is a deferred decal.
notes: Tell: a thorn ring contracts across the floor while a negative light drains the body and black smoke winds up the legs.
Impact: the life leaves as warm amber motes and mist, the only warm colour in the shot, under one inverted black ring frame.

The body is two mannequin layers. The outer shell withers from the chest outward, shrinks along its normals and is alpha-clipped into ragged holes; an inner, narrower bone body with ribs shows through them.
Residue: grey flakes of hide peel off and settle, a rot stain with a pale mould lip spreads under the feet and the eyes come back on as cold undead points.

name: Suspend Mortality
src: Target ally gains an extra reincarnation (revives on death) for many turns.
blurb: Grey grave-dust pours down around an ally like sand through an hourglass, then stops dead in the air; a pale gold double of the ally steps half a pace out of their body and a halo locks over its head as a spare life.
port: Niagara with a scalar that scales particle velocity to zero at the freeze, plus a light renderer on a few grains. The double is a second skeletal mesh with a translucent fresnel material driven by a copy-pose; the halo is a torus mesh with an emissive.
notes: Tell: a column of ash falls around the ally while an hourglass sigil draws itself on the floor in pale gold.
Impact: every falling grain stops in place at the same instant and catches a gold rim, the halo snaps shut as one bright ring held for three frames, and a warm grey light comes up from the sigil.
The double is a second mannequin drawn as a fresnel shell with drifting noise, offset behind the body and swaying on a slower phase, so it reads as the life held in reserve.
Residue: the suspended grains hang and barely drift, a few gold sparks climb the double, and the sigil cools to a ring of pale dust.

name: Carnival of Pain
src: For a few turns, whenever an enemy takes physical, fire or lightning damage, the nearest enemies take that much dark damage.
